ev.q: Risk of Rain is a 2013 roguelike platform game
As the players gain experience, they will level up, gaining more hit points and damage
There are over 110 items in the game
this itself is used to unlock more items and a playable character
Money can be used to open various chests, buy items at stores
The game supports up to ten cooperative players in online play
The game features a difficulty scale that increases with time
During this time, many more monsters, including at least one boss monster, will appear
Players control the survivor of a space freighter crash on a strange planet
If playing alone, the game is over when the player dies
